theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.dimSYT_eq_numSYTenum {n : ℕ} (p : n.Partition) :
dimSYT p = numSYTenum (Multiset.sort (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) p.parts)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.numSYTenum_eq_numStandardYoungTableaux (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
numSYTenum l = numStandardYoungTableaux (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.nat_card_standardFillings (l : List ℕ) :
Nat.card { a : List ℕ // a ∈ standardFillings l } = numSYTenum l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.nat_card_mem_subtype {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (L : List α) (h : L.Nodup) :
Nat.card { a : α // a ∈ L } = L.length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.standardFillings_nodup (l : List ℕ) :
(standardFillings l).Nodup

noncomputable def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytEquivStandardFillings {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
StandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl) ≃ { a : List ℕ // a ∈ standardFillings l }

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.listToSYT_sytToList {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (T : StandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)) :
listToSYT hl (sytToList l T.entry) ⋯ ⋯ = T

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytToList_mem_standardFillings {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (T : StandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)) :
sytToList l T.entry ∈ standardFillings l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.syt_entry_gridInj {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (T : StandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)) (i1 j1 i2 j2 : ℕ) (h1 : i1 < l.length) :
j1 < l[i1] → ∀ (h2 : i2 < l.length), j2 < l[i2] → T.entry i1 j1 = T.entry i2 j2 → i1 = i2 ∧ j1 = j2

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.StandardYoungTableau.ext_toSsyt {μ : YoungDiagram} {T1 T2 : StandardYoungTableau μ} (h : T1.toSsyt = T2.toSsyt) :
T1 = T2

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytToList_nodup (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hinj : ∀ (i1 j1 i2 j2 : ℕ) (h1 : i1 < l.length), j1 < l[i1] → ∀ (h2 : i2 < l.length), j2 < l[i2] → e i1 j1 = e i2 j2 → i1 = i2 ∧ j1 = j2) :
(sytToList l e).Nodup

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.mem_sytToList (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (v : ℕ) :
v ∈ sytToList l e ↔ ∃ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length), j < l[i] ∧ e i j = v

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytToList_entryFn (l a : List ℕ) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
sytToList l (entryFn l a) = a

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.rowsOf_entryFn (l a : List ℕ) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
rowsOf l (entryFn l a) = chunk l a

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.flatten_chunk (l a : List ℕ) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
(chunk l a).flatten = a

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.isStdFilling_of_entry (l a : List ℕ) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) (hrow : ∀ (i j1 j2 : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length), j1 < j2 → j2 < l[i] → entryFn l a i j1 < entryFn l a i j2) (hcol : ∀ (i j : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < l.length), j < l[i + 1] → entryFn l a i j < entryFn l a (i + 1) j) :
isStdFilling l a = true

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.colsOK_of (rows : List (List ℕ)) (h : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < rows.length) (j : ℕ) (hj2 : j < rows[i + 1].length) (hj1 : j < rows[i].length), rows[i][j] < rows[i + 1][j]) :
colsOK rows = true

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.strictInc_map_range (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (j1 j2 : ℕ), j1 < j2 → j2 < n → f j1 < f j2) :
strictInc (List.map f (List.range n)) = true

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_row_eq_map (l a : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
(chunk l a).getD i [] = List.map (entryFn l a i) (List.range l[i])

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_sytToList (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l[i]) :
entryFn l (sytToList l e) i j = e i j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytToList_length (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
(sytToList l e).length = l.sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_sytToList (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
chunk l (sytToList l e) = rowsOf l e

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.rowsOf_map_length (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
List.map (fun (x : List ℕ) => x.length) (rowsOf l e) = l

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.sytToList (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
List ℕ

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.rowsOf (l : List ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
List (List ℕ)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_flatten (l : List ℕ) (rs : List (List ℕ)) (h : List.map (fun (x : List ℕ) => x.length) rs = l) :
chunk l rs.flatten = rs

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.listToSYT {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (a : List ℕ) (hp : a.Perm (List.map (fun (x : ℕ) => x + 1) (List.range l.sum))) (hstd : isStdFilling l a = true) :
StandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.listToSsyt {l : List ℕ} (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (a : List ℕ) (hstd : isStdFilling l a = true) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
SemistandardYoungTableau (YoungDiagram.ofRowLens l hl)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.a_nodup (l a : List ℕ) (hp : a.Perm (List.map (fun (x : ℕ) => x + 1) (List.range l.sum))) :
a.Nodup

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.a_getElem_mem_Icc (l a : List ℕ) (hp : a.Perm (List.map (fun (x : ℕ) => x + 1) (List.range l.sum))) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < a.length) :
1 ≤ a[k] ∧ a[k] ≤ l.sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_eq_a_idx (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l[i]) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
entryFn l a i j = a[idx l i j]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.idx_injOn (l : List ℕ) (i1 j1 i2 j2 : ℕ) (hi1 : i1 < l.length) (hj1 : j1 < l[i1]) (hi2 : i2 < l.length) (hj2 : j2 < l[i2]) (heq : idx l i1 j1 = idx l i2 j2) :
i1 = i2 ∧ j1 = j2

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.idx_lt_sum (l : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l[i]) :
idx l i j < l.sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.take_sum_mono (l : List ℕ) (i k : ℕ) (h : i ≤ k) :
(List.take i l).sum ≤ (List.take k l).sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.take_sum_succ (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) :
(List.take (i + 1) l).sum = (List.take i l).sum + l[i]

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.idx (l : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.isStdFilling_col (l a : List ℕ) (h : isStdFilling l a = true) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (i1 i2 j : ℕ) (hlt : i1 < i2) (hi2 : i2 < l.length) (hj : j < l[i2]) :
entryFn l a i1 j < entryFn l a i2 j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.isStdFilling_col_aux (l a : List ℕ) (h : isStdFilling l a = true) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (i1 n j : ℕ) (hi2 : i1 + n + 1 < l.length) (hj : j < l[i1 + n + 1]) :
entryFn l a i1 j < entryFn l a (i1 + n + 1) j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.isStdFilling_adjcol (l a : List ℕ) (h : isStdFilling l a = true) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < l.length) (hj : j < l[i + 1]) :
entryFn l a i j < entryFn l a (i + 1) j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.isStdFilling_row (l a : List ℕ) (h : isStdFilling l a = true) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) (i j1 j2 : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j1 < j2) (hj2 : j2 < l[i]) :
entryFn l a i j1 < entryFn l a i j2

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_eq_row_getElem (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l[i]) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
entryFn l a i j = ((chunk l a).getD i [])[j]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_row_length (l a : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hlen : a.length = l.sum) :
((chunk l a).getD i []).length = l[i]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.take_sum_add_le (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) :
(List.take i l).sum + l[i] ≤ l.sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.colsOK_getElem (rows : List (List ℕ)) (h : colsOK rows = true) (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < rows.length) (j : ℕ) (hj2 : j < rows[i + 1].length) (hj1 : j < rows[i].length) :
rows[i][j] < rows[i + 1][j]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.strictInc_getElem (r : List ℕ) (h : strictInc r = true) (j1 j2 : ℕ) (hj : j1 < j2) (h2 : j2 < r.length) :
r[j1] < r[j2]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.strictInc_iff_chain (r : List ℕ) :
strictInc r = true ↔ List.IsChain (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) r

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_zero_of_col (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : l[i] ≤ j) :
entryFn l a i j = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_zero_of_row (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : l.length ≤ i) :
entryFn l a i j = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn_eq_getD (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l[i]) (hlen : (List.take i l).sum + l[i] ≤ a.length) :
entryFn l a i j = a.getD ((List.take i l).sum + j) 0

def QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.entryFn (l a : List ℕ) (i j : ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_getD (l a : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) :
(chunk l a).getD i [] = List.take l[i] (List.drop (List.take i l).sum a)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTEnum.chunk_length (l a : List ℕ) :
(chunk l a).length = l.length
